widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult female doctor from <Picture 1>. Preserve her identity, low black hair bun, white coat, green scrubs, stethoscope, and silver watch on her left wrist.
<Subject 2> is the adult male patient from <Picture 2>. Preserve his identity, short textured black hair, slate-blue T-shirt, black trousers, and white sneakers.
<Subject 3> is the consultation room from <Picture 3>. Preserve the desk, monitor, closed teal medical file, black smartphone, rear window and blinds, cabinets, trolley, and visitor chair. The doctor sits behind the desk on screen left; the patient sits on screen right and exits through the visible right-side doorway.

summary:
A realistic live-action Chinese drama scene, approximately 14 seconds. The patient politely ends his visit and leaves. The doctor silently acknowledges him, then answers her vibrating phone and speaks warmly to her husband. Generate distinct, stable, natural adult Mandarin voices: a calm male voice for the patient and a warm female voice for the doctor. There are no voice-reference recordings. Perform only the quoted dialogue, with synchronized mouth motion, no extra narrator, no audible husband, and no music.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1, approximately 0.0-3.5s] Medium close-up of the seated patient looking toward the doctor off screen left; her white-coated shoulder is softly blurred in the left foreground. Patient alone speaks: <d>[Chinese] 好吧，那……我先回去了，谢谢主任。</d> He then leans forward to stand.
[Shot 2, approximately 3.5-7.2s] Cut to a medium-wide two-shot in the reference room. The patient stands, gently moves the visitor chair back, and walks out to screen right by about 6.4s. The doctor gives one silent nod. Footsteps recede. At about 6.6s her black smartphone vibrates on the desk beside the closed file; she looks down.
[Shot 3, approximately 7.2-8.3s] Tight desk-level insert. The doctor's right hand picks up the phone and taps once to answer. The vibration stops. Continue the same physical action as she raises the phone to her right ear.
[Shot 4, approximately 8.3-14.0s] Medium close-up of the doctor, phone at her right ear. She relaxes and says softly: <d>[Chinese] 喂，老公……</d> During a short silent listening pause she glances at the watch on her left wrist, then continues: <d>[Chinese] 刚好下班，你等我一下。</d> Finish speaking by about 12.8s and hold a small natural smile through the quiet ending. Her husband is not heard.

continuity_and_sound:
Maintain stable identities, wardrobe, hands, daylight, furniture, eyelines, and the doctor-left/patient-right spatial axis. Only the designated speaker moves their mouth during each line. Quiet room ambience, chair scrape, clothing movement, footsteps, phone vibration and handling sounds accompany the actions. No ringtone, music, extra dialogue, subtitles, logos, or exaggerated effects. Times are approximate story beats; keep the final short tail quiet.
